description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish rounded thin-walled sac articulated as interlocking star-like lattice facets in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
